headline: Asia Needs $1 Trillion Annually in Energy Investment to Secure Supplies, McKinsey Says
summary: Asia will need up to $1 trillion annually in energy investment over the next 15 years—totaling $15 trillion through 2040—to meet rising demand and reduce exposure to supply disruptions, according to a McKinsey report.
why: Massive capital expenditure requirements for energy infrastructure highlight long-term financing needs across emerging Asian economies and provide substantial opportunities for industrial and clean tech sectors.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Long-term capital expenditure commitments drive structural demand for infrastructure developers, equipment suppliers, and energy providers.
